films.title: Chillar Party
films.overview: A gang of innocent but feisty kids who lead carefree lives in Chandan Nagar colony, take on the big bad world of politics when one of their friend's life is endangered.

films.title: Queen
films.overview: Rani, a 24-year-old homely girl, decides to go on her honeymoon alone when her fiancé calls off the wedding. Traveling around Europe, she finds joy, makes friends, and gains new-found independence.

films.title: Shaitaan
films.overview: Kabir and his family's fun weekend retreat takes terrifying turn when an intruder takes over the control of the  body of his teenage daughter, putting her at the mercy of his increasingly sinister orders.

films.title: Shaandaar
films.overview: Jagjinder Joginder, a wedding planner, brings together the dysfunctional family of businessman Bipin Arora while making arrangements for Bipin's daughter's destination wedding in London.

films.title: Super 30
films.overview: Based on life of Patna-based mathematician Anand Kumar who runs the famed Super 30 program for financially weak IIT aspirants in Patna.
